name: Vegan Farm
desc: No animals, no eggs, no dairy.

name: One Machine
desc: You may only ever use a single type of machine.

name: Renter's Life
desc: You cannot buy machines or land. Lease everything.

name: Boutique Farm
desc: At most 6 plots, but customers pay 40% more.

name: Single Crop Season
desc: Only one crop type may be planted each season.

name: Zero Waste
desc: Unsold byproducts cost you $1 each at the end of every day.

name: Hurried
desc: Days are 40% shorter. Crops still take the same number of days.

name: Harsh Weather
desc: Storms, frost and heatwaves are twice as likely.

name: Cheap Customers
desc: Everything sells for 20% less, but you start with double money.

name: Tired Soil
desc: Harvesting drains soil fertility twice as fast.

name: Free Market
desc: No contracts, and prices swing wildly and recover slowly.

name: Bread is Banned
desc: Nothing from the bakery: no bread, pies or cakes.

name: No Sweet Tooth
desc: Strawberries, jam, pies and cakes are all off the menu.
